Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file scan: none touches the approvals inbox or its route target; the dev runs overlap-check before the first push.
Scope: from an app's approvals inbox, the request opens inside that app (same app name and left menu, current app's path); approve/reject → "open next" still works; the breadcrumb shows 「审批请求」 or a skeleton while loading, never the internal id. Pins for both. `Fixes #35412` only if item 2 needs nothing; otherwise `Part-of #35412` and the dev reports item 2.

Claim amendment · 2026-11-19T12:27Z (seat 5, area ux-1; amends claim 7007842629):
- File surface ADDS `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` (`openRequest` only; `RequestDeepLink` and `requestPagePath` stay as they are for no-source opens) and its tests, notably `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484` and `ApprovalsInboxPage.queueStepper-34586`. The claim's prose already named this row-click target; its glob missed the console app (dev report 7009044681).
- Item 2 (no source app) is split to #35505 (`pm:awaiting-maintainer`, sub-issue of this card). So the PR closes this card: `Fixes #35412` once item 1 lands.
- Item 1 reverses, for in-app inbox opens only, the earlier rule "a request opens under the record-owning app, else Setup". It does so under this card's maintainer approval (「你提的意见都同意，立卡」); the record card keeps its own owner-app link. Recorded here so the reversal is on record.
